tax.summary: Interest on bank deposits is taxed at a flat 20%, taken by the bank before you are paid (Section 24(B)(1) of the Tax Code, as amended by RA 12214, effective 1 July 2025). The law says 'any currency bank deposit', so peso and dollar deposits are both covered, and licensed digital banks are covered the same way. Long-term (5+ year) deposits are no longer tax-free for new deposits; only deposits placed before 1 July 2025 keep their old rate until they mature.
tax.longTermExemption: Before 1 July 2025, interest on deposits kept 5 years or more was tax-free, and 3 to 5 year deposits paid a lower tax (5% to 12%). Under CMEPA (RA 12214) interest on any bank deposit for individuals is taxed a flat 20%, whatever the term. Deposits placed before 1 July 2025 keep their old rate until they mature (Section 28, transitory provision). New deposits and renewals get no long-term exemption.

exemptions.why: DOF says savings in Pag-IBIG, SSS and GSIS programs such as MP2 remain tax-free; they are not bank deposits.

exemptions.what: Deposits placed before 1 July 2025 (grandfathered until maturity)
exemptions.why: RA 12214 Section 28: exemptions and lower rates on instruments issued before 1 July 2025 stay until the agreement matures.
RA 12214 adds Sec 32(B)(7)(g): interest on government bonds funding priority national programs, as set by the Finance Secretary, is excluded from income. Not a bank deposit.

pdic.summary: PDIC insures deposits in member banks up to ₱1,000,000 per depositor, per bank (since 15 March 2025). Crypto, e-wallet balances held outside a bank, and Pag-IBIG MP2 are not bank deposits, so PDIC does not cover them.
